title: Page 9
content_zh:
「嗯。」其实他只要有这份心意，她就非常开心了，有没有补偿根本不重要。
就算没有花灯、没有杂耍艺人，只要能和他像现在一样互相依偎着，她就已经很满足、很幸福了……
「雪莹，当我的王后吧。」他的话语中蕴含着深浓情感。「我的心只容得下你一个女人，这一辈子，除了你之外，我不会再纳其他的妃子。」
「但朝臣们或太后会答应吗？」她虽然开心，却不得不考虑到现实，大臣他们一定会劝他多立妃子，好多生子嗣，替王室开枝散叶。
「这你不必担心，无论如何，他们都动摇不了我的决定，你只需要相信我就够了。」
「我相信你。」她毫不犹豫地回答。
「那就好。」他欣喜地笑着，将心爱的人儿紧紧锁在怀中，贪恋着和她相互依偎的甜蜜滋味。
他的胸膛好暖、好舒服，她也舍不得叫他放手，脸上的笑容洋溢着满满的幸福。
宗薰和朵儿在一旁瞧着他们俩形影相依，难分难舍，颇有默契地相视一笑，识相地不出声破坏气氛，反正团圆饭晚一些吃，也没什么大不了的。
过了年之后，春天也即将到来，他们的希望就在春天，这一次……肯定没问题的……
除夕过后，兰霆便决定回到兰凌王宫，他答应过姜鸳不会在云渺山耽搁太久时间，现在宗雪莹已暂时脱离危险，他也能放心地回宫去。
兰霆一回宫之后，便马上到姜鸳的寝宫去，姜鸳瞧见他脸色苍白，担忧地问：「霆儿，你是病了吗？母后马上命人唤御医……」
「母后，不必唤御医，儿臣不会有事。」
「到底怎么了？」不会有事？这句话非常奇怪，他肯定有事情瞒着她。
「儿臣有一事要向母后禀明。」兰霆没有回答姜鸳的困惑，语气坚定地说道：「儿臣要立雪莹为后。」
「呃？」姜鸳愣了一下，之后才回过神来。「等等，你之前不是说雪莹快撑不下去了，现在回来却告诉母后要立雪莹为后？」
「这一时之间很难解释清楚，总之雪莹已经暂时没事，等雪莹毒解了之后，儿臣便要立她为后。」
姜鸳沉默了一会儿，之后轻叹口气，知道儿子对宗雪莹用情至深，会做出这种决定，其实也是可以预见的。「只要你知道自己在做什么就好，母后也不干预了。」
「多谢母后。」兰霆欣喜地答谢，到时候那些臣子们要是想劝阻他，只要母后站在他这边，他们也无计可施。
「所以你可以告诉母后，你到底怎么了吧？」姜鸳可还是没忽略掉他苍白的脸色。「真的不必请御医来？你要是不说清楚，母后便无法放心。」

兰霆犹豫了一会儿，本不想让母后知道，免得让她一同担心，但要是不把话说清楚，恐怕母后是不会罢休，只好回答。「其实……为了救雪莹，儿臣让隐族族长在儿臣和雪莹身上施同命咒，此生此世两人便祸福相依、生死与共……」
姜鸳惊愕地瞪大双眼，不敢相信儿子居然如此冲动，为了救宗雪莹而让自身涉险。
「母后，儿臣知道事后才向母后告知这件事，已经改变不了既定的结果，但还是希望母后能够谅解。」
「难道你能保证这辈子都不后悔？」姜鸳的语气有些怨怒，将来会有什么变数，没有任何人知道，他难道不怕自己终究还是会喜欢上其他女人，反而害了自己？
「儿臣不后悔，这一世儿臣对雪莹的心意都不会改变。」兰霆勾起一抹淡笑，笑中蕴含着无限柔情，也表达着他不变的决心。
他们俩之间的缘分，从十年前就开始牵起了，而他们彼此之间的感情，也早就像丝线般纠缠不清，想分也分不开。
他们俩注定要在一起的，经过了这么多事情，并没有削弱这一份情感，反而越来越紧密、坚定，无人可以拆散。
姜鸳看着儿子那饱含柔情的微笑，她很清楚，这样的微笑，只会在宗雪莹面前出现，只有宗雪莹能够引出他内心最深处的温柔，得到他倾尽全心的宠爱。
罢了，儿孙自有儿孙福，只要儿子不后悔，她便诚心祝福他们，希望他们能够顺利地白头到老，痴情永不改变……
第9章(2)
转眼之间，已是春暖花开之时。
「王，关于赋税的事……」
御书房里，专司赋税的官员正向兰霆报告事情，但兰霆却是异常的心不在焉。
春天到了，百灵昙也该开了吧？不知道隐族人有没有顺利将花给带回，让雪莹服下？
他每日都在等待好消息传回来，却迟迟等不到，这让他忍不住烦躁，却还是得强逼自己镇定地处理国事。
「……王？」官员见兰霆心不在焉，不知道在想些什么，只好斗胆地提醒道。
兰霆猛然回过神，装作若无其事地道：「继续说。」
「是……」
然而就在这一刻，他的胸口出现一股异样的热流，灼痛着他的心，让他脸色一变，痛苦地捂着心口，几乎快喘不过气来。
这是怎么一回事？为什么他会突然如此难受，痛得他就快昏厥了……

「王？」官员一见兰霆出现异样，惊慌地赶紧命令守在门旁的太监。「快、快去请御医，王身子不适！」
「是！」太监惊急地冲出御书房，可不敢耽搁任何一丁点时间。
「王，您还好吗？御医快来了，请王再忍忍……」
胸口那股痛意及灼热感迅速蔓延全身，教他痛得直冒汗，胸口就像是有把火在燃烧，呼出的气都是烫的。
是雪莹发生了什么事吗？这种痛太不寻常，肯定是有什么事情发生了！
过了好一会儿，太监终于带着御医急忙冲入御书房里，十万火急地喊道：「御医来了！」
御医马上来到桌案边，替兰霆把脉，一张脸几乎要皱成一团，因为兰霆的脉象异常急促紊乱，比寻常人的脉搏跳动还要快上一倍，是他从不曾遇到过的。
兰霆强忍着身上难耐的痛楚，等着御医诊断出状况，但御医却说不出个所以然来，接着他发现体内的异样又有所改变，原本的灼热感逐渐散去，取而代之的是一种沁凉的感觉游走全身，洗去他的一身痛苦，整个人顿时轻松起来。
「咦？」御医不解地瞪大眼，王的脉象又变了，似乎……逐渐恢复平稳，又和寻常人没什么两样。
等到一身的沁凉退去之后，兰霆明显地感受到，五脏六腑原本的刺痛感减轻许多。
莫非是雪莹已经服下百灵昙，所以她身上的毒一解，病厄去除，他体内的刺痛感也跟着减轻？
肯定是这样的，要不然他的身子也不会有刚才的异样感受。
「太好了……哈哈哈……真是太好了……」他难掩欣喜地朗笑出声，却吓得御医和官员们一愣一愣的，完全不懂到底是怎么一回事。
五日之后，留在云渺山的使者快马回宫，兰霆马上将使者召进御书房里，迫不及待想知道宗雪莹的状况。
「王，隐族族人已顺利取回百灵昙，让宗姑娘服下，宗姑娘的身子正逐渐地康复。」
「太好了！」兰霆欣喜地问：「他们是什么时候让雪莹服下百灵昙的？」
「就在五日前。」
这和他所猜想的一样，他身子出现异样不适的时候正是雪莹服下百灵昙时，两人几乎是同时有所感觉。
「王，另外隐族族长要卑职转达，虽然宗姑娘身上的毒已解，但还需要一个月的时间调养好身子，才能启程下山，请王体谅。」
content_en:
"Yeah." In fact, as long as he had this intention, she would be very happy, and it didn't matter whether there was compensation or not.
Even if there were no lanterns or jugglers, as long as she could cuddle up with him like now, she would be very satisfied and happy...
"Xueying, be my queen." There was deep emotion in his words. "My heart can only accommodate you as a woman. In this life, I will not accept any other concubines except you."
"But will the courtiers or the Queen Mother agree?" Although she was happy, she had to consider the reality. The ministers would definitely persuade him to have more concubines, have more children, and expand the branches of the royal family.
"You don't have to worry about this. No matter what, they can't shake my decision. You just need to believe in me."
"I believe you." She replied without hesitation.
"That's good." He smiled happily, locking his beloved tightly in his arms, coveting the sweet taste of cuddling with her.
His chest was so warm and comfortable, and she couldn't bear to ask him to let go. The smile on her face was filled with happiness.
Zong Xun and Duo'er watched from the sidelines as they were inseparable. They looked at each other and smiled in a tacit understanding. They knew each other well and did not spoil the atmosphere. Anyway, it was no big deal to have the reunion dinner later.
After the New Year, spring is coming, and their hope lies in spring. This time... there will definitely be no problem...
After New Year's Eve, Lan Ting decided to return to Lanling Palace. He promised Jiang Yuan that he would not stay in Yunmiao Mountain for too long. Now that Zong Xueying was temporarily out of danger, he could return to the palace with peace of mind.
As soon as Lan Ting returned to the palace, he immediately went to Jiang Yuan's bedroom. Jiang Yuan saw his pale face and asked worriedly: "Ting'er, are you sick? The queen mother immediately ordered someone to call the imperial doctor..."
"Mother, there is no need to call the imperial doctor, my son will be fine."
"What's going on?" Is everything going to be okay? This sentence is very strange. He must be hiding something from her.
"I have something to tell my mother." Lan Ting did not answer Jiang Yuan's confusion, but said firmly: "I want to make Xueying my queen."
"Huh?" Jiang Yuan was stunned for a moment, and then came back to his senses. "Wait a minute, didn't you say before that Xueying couldn't hold on any longer, and now you came back and told your mother that you wanted to make Xueying your queen?"
"It's hard to explain clearly at this moment. In short, Xueying is fine for the time being. After Xueying's poison is cured, I will make her my queen."
Jiang Yuan was silent for a while, and then sighed softly, knowing that his son had a deep affection for Zong Xueying, and it was actually foreseeable that he would make such a decision. "As long as you know what you are doing, your mother will not interfere."
"Thank you, Queen Mother." Lan Ting thanked him happily. If the ministers wanted to dissuade him, as long as the Queen Mother was on his side, there would be nothing they could do.
"So you can tell your mother what's wrong with you?" Jiang Yuanke still didn't ignore his pale face. "Is there really no need to invite the imperial doctor? If you don't explain clearly, the queen mother will not be able to rest assured."
Lan Ting hesitated for a while. He didn't want his mother to know, so as not to worry her too, but if he didn't speak clearly, he might not give up, so he had to answer. "Actually... in order to save Xueying, Erchen asked the Yin clan chief to cast the same fate curse on Erchen and Xueying. In this life, the two of them will be dependent on each other, and share life and death..."
Jiang Yuan's eyes widened in shock, unable to believe that his son was so impulsive and put himself in danger to save Zong Xueying.
"Mother, I only told my mother about this after I found out. It can't change the outcome, but I still hope my mother can forgive me."
"Can you guarantee that you will never regret it in this life?" Jiang Yuan's tone was a bit resentful. No one knows what changes will happen in the future. Isn't he afraid that he will fall in love with other women after all and harm himself instead?
"My son, I have no regrets,My son's feelings for Xueying will not change in this life. Lan Ting gave a faint smile, which contained infinite tenderness and expressed his unchanging determination.
The fate between the two of them began ten years ago, and their feelings for each other have long been entangled like threads, and they cannot be separated even if they want to.
The two of them are destined to be together. After so many things, this relationship has not weakened, but has become more and more close and firm, and no one can break it apart.
Jiang Yuan looked at her son's tender smile. She knew very well that such a smile would only appear in front of Zong Xueying. Only Zong Xueying could bring out the deepest tenderness in his heart and gain his full love.
Forget it, children and grandchildren will have their own blessings. As long as her son does not regret it, she will sincerely bless them and hope that they can grow old smoothly and their infatuation will never change...
Chapter 9(2)
In the blink of an eye, it’s spring and the flowers are blooming.
"King, regarding taxes..."
In the royal study, the tax official was reporting the matter to Lan Ting, but Lan Ting was unusually absent-minded.
Spring is here, and the Bai Ling Tan should be in bloom, right? I wonder if the Yin people successfully brought the flowers back to Xueying to take them?
He waited for the good news to come back every day, but he couldn't wait for it. This made him irritated, but he still had to force himself to handle state affairs calmly.
"...King?" The official saw that Lan Ting was absent-minded and didn't know what he was thinking, so he had to remind him boldly.
Lan Ting suddenly came back to his senses, pretending to be nonchalant and said: "Keep talking."
"Yes..."
However, at this moment, a strange heat appeared in his chest, burning his heart, causing his expression to change, and he clutched his heart in pain, almost out of breath.
What's going on? Why did he suddenly feel so uncomfortable? It was so painful that he almost fainted...
"King?" When the official saw Lan Ting acting strangely, he panicked and quickly ordered the eunuch guarding the door. "Hurry, go and get the imperial doctor, the king is not feeling well!"
"Yes!" The eunuch rushed out of the imperial study room in panic, not daring to waste any time.
"King, are you okay? The doctor is coming soon. Please be patient..."
The pain and burning sensation in his chest quickly spread throughout his body, causing him to sweat in pain. His chest felt like a fire was burning, and his breath was hot.
Did something happen to Xueying? This pain is so unusual, something must be happening!
After a while, the eunuch finally rushed into the imperial study with the imperial doctor and shouted anxiously: "The imperial doctor is here!"
The imperial doctor immediately came to the table and took Lan Ting's pulse, his face almost wrinkled, because Lan Ting's pulse was extremely fast and disorderly, beating twice as fast as an ordinary person's pulse, which he had never encountered before.
Lan Ting endured the unbearable pain in his body and waited for the imperial doctor to diagnose the condition, but the imperial doctor could not explain it. Then he found that the strangeness in his body had changed again. The original burning sensation gradually dissipated, and was replaced by a cool feeling that traveled throughout his body, washing away all his pain, and his whole body suddenly became relaxed.
"Huh?" The imperial doctor's eyes widened in confusion. The king's pulse condition changed again. It seemed that... he was gradually returning to a stable state, and he was no different from an ordinary person.
After the chill all over his body subsided, Lan Ting clearly felt that the original tingling sensation in his internal organs was much lessened.
Could it be that Xueying had already taken Bailingtan, so as soon as the poison in her body was detoxified and the illness was removed, the tingling sensation in his body also reduced?
It must be like this, otherwise his body wouldn't have the strange feeling just now.
"It's great... Hahaha... It's so great..." He couldn't hide his joy and laughed out loud, but the doctor and officials were so frightened that they didn't understand what was going on.
Five days later, the envoy who stayed in Yunmiao Mountain quickly returned to the palace, and Lan Ting immediately summoned the envoy into the imperial study.Here, I can’t wait to know Zong Xueying’s condition.
"King, the Yin people have successfully retrieved Bai Ling Tan and asked Miss Zong to take it. Miss Zong is gradually recovering."
"Great!" Lan Ting asked happily: "When did they let Xueying take Bailingtan?"
"Just five days ago."
This was just as he had guessed. The time when he felt strangely unwell was when Xueying took Bai Lingtan, and the two of them felt it almost at the same time.
"Your Majesty, the leader of the Yin Clan would like to humbly convey that although the poison in Miss Zong's body has been cured, she still needs a month to recover before she can leave the mountain. Please forgive her."
